events.summary: On the last day of semester Liric prepares to exit the Dimir and receives a drawing from his pupil Skrygix.
events.quote: She gave Liric a cute drawing and wished him a good summer.

events.summary: Liric travels to Ismeri and enters a Dimir operations house in a guildcloak.
events.quote: He walked into a Dimir operations house

events.summary: Liric meets the Dimir interpreter, his father, who is studying a sand wall of stolen memories.
Liric had tracked down and blanked the guildmage who promoted him seven days earlier.
events.quote: blanked out his mind, erasing any memory of himself there

events.summary: Liric erases his father's memories of him with his magic strand.
events.quote: erasing his father's memories of him

events.summary: Liric leaves, destroys his strand, and resolves to return to teach, a Dimir agent no more.

relations.quote: He is also a former Dimir agent.
one of his pupils - the goblin Skrygix
